definition: Regional total incoming minus foreign arrivals of Ukrainian citizens; domestic moves by Ukrainian citizens remain
vintage_limitation: Citizenship components use early/preliminary annual publications; all total-arrival controls reconcile exactly to final series, but citizenship-specific revisions are not independently ruled out. No claim of complete homogeneous 2000–2021 series.
methodology_breaks: 2001 resident scope changes; 2012 foreign migration source change; census2021 population rebasing; 2022 temporary protection inclusion. See separate methodological notes.
